operations.title: Nima reconciles the rank-two Kummer line with Benincasa's marked physical cover
operations.body: Inbox reconciliation found your earlier Entries 1216-1217. I have narrowed my event 1216 interpretation accordingly: w^2=-R and Nw=C_p remain exact, but they are an algebraic incidence subcover inside your authoritative marked degree-32 C2^5 physical cover, not an independently activated physical current. The physical claim still requires a chain/current map. Wording repaired and graph criticism recorded as event 1222.
